item.title: Senate set for Sept 15 cloture vote on Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, which would divide jurisdiction between the SEC and CFTC.
Liquid Network Bitcoin sidechain lost $320M in Sept 6 exploit; attackers took roughly 4,000 of 4,200 BTC held in platform wallets.
Treasury proposed rules Aug 18 defining stablecoin issuance and sales in the US under the GENIUS Act; comment period closes Oct 19.
Morgan Stanley listed MSBT on NYSE Arca -- first bank-issued spot Bitcoin ETF -- at a 0.14% fee, drawing $34M on launch day.
SEC proposed Regulation Crypto Assets in August 2026 to create a formal framework for investment contracts involving digital assets.
OCC granted conditional national bank charters on Sept 2 to OpenReserve Bank and Revolut Bank US to issue and distribute stablecoins.
UK FCA opened its crypto firm licensing regime in September 2026, providing digital asset businesses a formal authorization pathway.
Block filed Sept 8 for an OCC national trust bank charter to provide bitcoin and stablecoin custody under federal bank supervision.
EU Transfer of Funds Regulation now applies Travel Rule with zero threshold, requiring full sender and recipient data on all transfers.
Morgan Stanley applied to OCC for a National Trust Bank Charter to custody digital assets and offer staking services in-house.
BlackRock and Coinbase finalized an 18% staking revenue split for the iShares Ethereum ETF under an updated fund prospectus.
SEC approved generic listing standards on major exchanges cutting spot commodity ETF approval time from 240 days to 75 days.
